persona.name: dumper
persona.reply: You over-explain. Answer what it asks from your knowledge bank, then add one or two sentences it did not ask for: a fact from the bank it has not asked about yet, or harmless backstory (who it is for, why, a worry). Never add a new requirement that is not in the bank. If it asks whether to proceed, say yes and add one more remark. Two to four sentences.
persona.giveUp: ok ok, just do whatever you think is best, honestly i trust you
persona.nudge: Oh, please just go ahead and try it anyway. I'd rather have something than nothing, and I know the free plan has its limits, that's fine by me.

bank.The request in full, as you would have w: Put these kitchen photos side by side in one landscape 16:9 image. Old kitchen on the left, renovated one on the right, labeled “Before” and “After”. Keep both photos as they are, just fit them neatly.
bank.Which photo goes where?: kitchen-before.jpg on the left; kitchen-after.jpg on the right.
bank.Label wording and language: Before and After, exactly, in English.
bank.Size and format: One landscape 16:9 image; free-tier resolution is fine.
bank.Layout and styling: Equal-sized panels with readable labels; font, colors and spacing are your call.
bank.Photo edits: Do not change either scene. Fit the complete photos without stretching; padding is fine.

messages.text: Could you put the attached old kitchen photo and renovated kitchen photo side by side for me? I’ve been looking back at the kitchen project and would love to see the difference all together. I mean one landscape 16:9 image, with the old kitchen pic on the left labeled “Before” and the renovated kitchen pic on the right labeled “After”. Please keep both photos as they are and just fit them neatly into that image. It’s a little sentimental seeing how much the kitchen has changed.
